about: Registry of every source the content files draw on. Content files refer to sources only by id, written as src:<id>. The reference files themselves are read-only and are never copied into this repo. 'file' and 'folder' locate an internal file (folder is relative to the FODW II project folder, or to the team Guides folder when 'library' is 'guides'). 'url' is set only for public sources.
idRules: Form: <kind>-<slug>, lowercase, words joined by hyphens.
Kinds: coursemap, template, reading, guide, assignment, perusall, script, jobaid, article, example, tool, ext (published work outside TLI).

Module is a field, not part of the id, except for assignments and readings whose module never changes. Several source files carry the wrong module number, so 'module' always follows the V3 course map.
An id never changes once used. If a source is replaced by a new version, add a new id and set 'replacedBy' on the old one.
